name: Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer
description: This Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer was part of Moff Kentor Sarne's fleet. It was fitted with an experimental weapon, a devastator torpedo launcher. In 8 ABY, the vessel participated in the Battle of Danoor. During the engagement, the Star Destroyer launched one of its torpedoes towards the planet Danoor, obliterating everything within a ten-kilometer radius of the blast zone.
